scope: RFC 8259 JSON text (object or array root, JSON_TOKENER_STRICT, trailing JSON whitespace only) decoded into a json_object tree
family_note: Own resumable character-by-character state machine in json_tokener.c building json_object values with linkhash.c tables and printbuf.c buffers; numbers via json-c's own integer parsing and strtod.
